Privacy Policy

⚠️ Draft template — not legal advice. Replace every [PLACEHOLDER] and have this reviewed by a qualified adviser before launch, especially as you are processing personal data and taking payments under UK GDPR.

This policy explains how [BUSINESS / TRADER NAME] ("we", "us") collects and uses personal data when you use [WEBSITE URL] (the "Service"). We are the data controller. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL].

1. Data we collect

  • Account data — your email address and authentication identifiers, handled by our authentication provider (Supabase).
  • Subscription & payment data — your subscription status and billing metadata. Card details are entered directly with our payment processor (Stripe); we never see or store your full card number.
  • Technical data — IP address, device/browser type and basic usage, via server logs and (only with consent) analytics.
  • Cookies — see our Cookie Policy.

2. How and why we use it (legal bases)

  • To provide accounts and premium features — performance of a contract.
  • To take payment and manage subscriptions — performance of a contract.
  • To secure and maintain the Service — legitimate interests.
  • Analytics and improvement — consent (you can withdraw it any time via Cookie settings).

3. Processors we share data with

  • Stripe — payment processing (stripe.com/privacy).
  • Supabase — authentication and database hosting.
  • Netlify — website hosting and delivery.
  • Google Fonts — serves the site's web fonts (may receive your IP when fonts load).

We do not sell your personal data.

4. International transfers

Some processors are outside the UK/EEA. Where that happens, transfers rely on appropriate safeguards (e.g. UK IDTA / EU Standard Contractual Clauses). [Confirm with each provider.]

5. Retention

We keep account data while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards, and payment records for as long as required by law (e.g. tax/accounting).

6. Your rights

Under UK GDPR you may access, correct, erase, restrict or port your data, and object to certain processing. To exercise these, email [CONTACT EMAIL]. You can also complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.

7. Children

The Service is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their data.

8. Changes

We may update this policy; material changes will be posted here with a new date.
